protocol.peakDefinition: Maximum observed Runtime.getHeapUsage.usedSize bytes on the same page target as post-GC. Native/process/worker memory excluded. Unknown remains null. Five runs support completion checks only; estimate latency tail per size on a separate 40+40 sample per-size study before advertising a percentile SLA.
protocol.capacityClaim: Measure the historical 6,30,118-section fixtures. Their page counts depend on actual pagination. No 500/1,000-page claim.
